paper_title: Constraining Axion-Like Particles with HAWC Observations of TeV Blazars
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (plotted as g_agamma in units of 10^-11 GeV^-1; axis multiplier applied)
notes: Paper reports a new observed exclusion from a joint-likelihood stacked analysis of 7 blazars using HAWC 3HWC + ACT data: ALP hypothesis excluded at >3sigma for g_agamma >~ 3e-11 GeV^-1 for ALP masses below ~200-300 neV (Fig. 3). Encoded as an approximately flat bound spanning the Fig. 3 mass axis lower edge (0.01 neV = 1e-11 eV) up to 300 neV = 3e-7 eV. Exact contour shape (Fig. 3) not digitizable from text; the bound weakens above ~200 neV. Not a dark-matter haloscope search (astrophysical photon-ALP propagation), so no local DM density assumed.
